newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Somague capital call detailed.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Somague capital call detailed.

text.p: Portuguese construction company Somague is issuing 3.3 million new shares reserved for existing shareholders at a price of 1,550 escudos per share, bankers forming part of the issue syndicate said.
The announcement was made by Somague to a closed meeting of bankers and analysts at the Lisbon bourse on Tuesday, they said.
Somague's share price was losing 3.6 percent at 1,690 escudos on Wednesday in lively trade of 122,500 shares.
Trade in rights to the capital call will run from May 20 to 26, with subscription to the capital rise ending on June 3.
Somague officials were not available to comment.
The capital call will finance the purchase of 100 percent of building firm Assiconstroi, priced at 10.3 billion escudos.
Somague's shareholder equity stands at 11 billion.
Last April 9, Somague launched a 3.25 billion bond issue, also part of the financing package for Assicontroi.
